stem: Which statement describes how the Transcontinental Railroad affected the United States during the late 1800s?

options.label: F
options.text: The railroad contributed to the rapid settlement and growth of towns in the West.

options.label: G
options.text: The railroad caused a rapid decline in agriculture and mining in the West.

options.label: H
options.text: The railroad contributed to population growth and increased sharecropping in the East.

options.label: J
options.text: The railroad prompted Congress to buy land and create national parks in the East.
